Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
[snip]

The Rumor Mill has two disadvantages - costing a blood
>from your minion to get the intercept, and it's not "sale-able", i.e.
>you can't give intercept to another Methuselah's vampire - that are
>not balanced by its lower cost.

Skaffen, GREAT fiction!! However I believe you are mistaken about the Rumor
Mill (or I have been playing it wrong for 5 years now)
Card text says nothing about it's saleability.

The Rumor Mill, Tabloid Newspaper [Sabbat, SW]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location. Tap this card and choose a vampire. Once during the
current action, the chosen vampire may burn 1 blood to get +1 intercept

It does not say "choose a vampire you control" so I figure you CAN use it to
sell the intercept. You simply tap and choose any vampire, who can then burn
a
blood to get one intercept during the action.
Or am I wrong??

Tim Eijpe
